_note: Behavioral-only pool for the general practice section. Not tied to any job description. Each question carries exactly one theme in tags.

questions.text: Tell me about the best team you've ever worked on. What made it work?
Describe a time you had to work with someone whose style was the opposite of yours.
Tell me about a time you covered for a teammate who was struggling.
When have you had to rely completely on someone else to deliver? How did you handle it?
Describe a time a handoff between you and another team went badly.
Tell me about a time you joined a team mid-project. How did you get up to speed?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did it resolve?
Describe a time you disagreed with your manager's decision.
Tell me about a time you had to say no to someone senior to you.
Describe a conflict you handled badly. What would you do differently?
Tell me about a time two people on your team were stuck in a disagreement. What did you do?
When have you had to defend a decision that was unpopular with your team?
Walk me through the hardest problem you've solved at work.

Describe a project everyone thought would fail. What happened?
Tell me about the most technically demanding thing you've built.
When have you had to learn something difficult very quickly?
Describe a problem where your first three attempts didn't work.

Describe your biggest professional mistake.
